policy.statement: Every vitest coverage exclusion is a classified, owned, expiring debt entry. An exclusion with no owner, no justification, or a passed review date is a broken gate, not a covered file.

classifications.PERMANENT_STRUCTURAL: Cannot be measured in-process (spawned-process shims, types-only modules, build output). Requires a structural reason instead of a review date.
classifications.DEAD_CODE: No production importer. Excluded because nothing ships it. Removal is mandatory, not optional.
classifications.CONTRACT_ONLY: Imported by its own contract test only. Ships a schema, not a capability; contract tests alone never certify.
classifications.SHIPPED_SURFACE: Reachable from a shipped CLI verb, release gate, or MCP tool. The v5 GA hard gate removes every entry in this class.

policy.reviewBySemantics: A passed reviewBy fails the gate. The date is a deadline to either cover the file or delete it — never a silent renewal.
policy.shippedSurfaceCeilingMeaning: Ratchet over shipped surfaces that are not PERMANENT_STRUCTURAL, not a target. The count may fall (removal, merge, real tests) and may never rise. Structural entries are excluded from the count because they are evidenced by a structural reason rather than a removable gap.

entries.structuralReason: Spawned-process entry point. A child process's istanbul report cannot merge into the parent run, so in-process instrumentation is unmeasurable. All transport logic lives in src/mcp/transport.ts and IS ratchet-covered.
entries.justification: bug-audit G6 precedent: the same structural class as dist/**. Coverage moves to tests/contract/mcp-transport.spec.ts, which spawns the real binary.

entries.structuralReason: Type-only module. Compiles to no executable code, so an instrumented run has nothing to execute.
entries.justification: Widely imported for types only; no runtime statements exist to cover.

entries.structuralReason: Type-only module shared by the forensics parsers.
entries.justification: No executable code paths.

entries.structuralReason: Type-only module with no importer outside type positions.
entries.justification: No executable code paths.

entries.removalPlan: V5-090 — merge into cross-file; the shared-import + 20-char line heuristic is a partial duplicate of a covered analysis.
entries.justification: Shipped as `analyze`; duplicates cross-file and contains an unfixed process.cwd() resolution bug. Merged away rather than covered.

entries.removalPlan: V5-090 — deprecate then remove in 5.0. The ROI model is unsupported by any measurement Mjölnir can make.
entries.justification: Shipped as `business-case`; renders an ROI projection no evidence supports. Deprecate, do not cover.

entries.removalPlan: V5-035 — regenerate Azure/Jenkins templates with least-privilege permissions, then cover them.
entries.justification: Shipped as `ci-adapter`; template generators are real but their emitted workflows use the wrong path/permissions. Fix the behaviour, then cover it.

entries.removalPlan: V5-083 — become a projection of the canonical proof; hardcoded zeros are removed first.
entries.justification: Shipped as `dashboard`; hardcoded zeros and an independent verdict make it a trust violation, not a coverage gap.

entries.removalPlan: V5-090 — deprecate then remove in 5.0. SSO/compliance content is template text, not a capability.
entries.justification: Shipped as `enterprise`; fabricates SSO and compliance posture. Deprecate, do not cover.

entries.removalPlan: V5-001 — remove the fabricated values now; V5-083 — make it a proof projection.
entries.justification: Shipped as `exec-report`; rendered numbers without provenance and an independent release verdict.

entries.removalPlan: V5-090 — deprecate then remove in 5.0. A file-existence proxy is not a maturity measurement.
entries.justification: Shipped as `maturity`; hardcoded 75/70/65/30 scores and a `ruleCount = 79` fallback invented from file existence.

entries.removalPlan: W7 — keep as the policy file surface, but evaluate it against the canonical proof (V5-073) and cover it.
entries.justification: Shipped as `policy`; real behaviour that must survive to 5.0, so it gets covered rather than removed.

entries.removalPlan: V5-001 — stop reporting empty proposals as updates; V5-090 — merge review/stats into the suppression ledger.
entries.justification: Shipped as `quarantine`; emitted empty proposals, zero statistics, and a false "updated" confirmation.

entries.removalPlan: V5-083 — become a proof projection; a GO/NO-GO verdict computed here is the verdict-spl sprawl the canonical proof removes.
entries.justification: Shipped as `release-report`; hardcoded zeros and a GO verdict reachable with no runtime evidence.

entries.removalPlan: V5-001 — stop fabricating Playwright entries from static findings; V5-090 — hand rendering to the reporter package.
entries.justification: Shipped as `report`; invents Playwright results that were never executed and reports `passed` on zero findings.

entries.removalPlan: V5-090 — merge into trust-trend; dashboards render stored evidence and never invent truth.
entries.justification: Shipped as `trend`; duplicates trust-trend, forces a framework count, and is non-deterministic across runs.

entries.removalPlan: V5-006 — wire m26:audit into `certify` so the validators gate engineering certification, then cover the validator branches.
entries.justification: Runs inside the release gate via `npm run m26:audit`. A gate that is not covered is a gate that can silently stop working.

entries.removalPlan: V5-007 — single-source the version identity, then cover the drift-detection branches.
entries.justification: Runs inside `npm run version:check` on every certify. Version drift detection that is itself untested is exactly the class of defect this ledger exists to expose.

entries.removalPlan: V5-038 — retire the independent HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW triage authority so classification derives from the single evidence verdict.
entries.justification: Shipped through `triage` and the MCP server. Low branch density, but it also carries an independent verdict authority that Wave 4 removes — fix the authority, then cover it.

entries.removalPlan: V5-080 — generate VERBS, help, README, and the site reference from one command manifest, which makes the entry point fully reachable by tests.
entries.justification: The shipped entry point. Every verb registration is a branch; a generated command manifest (V5-080) is what lifts it above the floor.

entries.structuralReason: Build output, not source. Coverage is measured on src/** before tsdown emits it.
entries.justification: Generated artifacts carry no independent test surface.
